name: Transfix Person
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 4, inquisitor 4, mesmerist 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner/unchained summoner 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one humanoid
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target to become paralyzed freeze in place. It is aware and breathes normally but cannot take any actions, even speech. You specify a condition that will end it like “Wait until my master returns.”. This condition can be stated in a way that can never feasibly be met, like “Wait here until you see dawn’s light” while underground. For every hour the target may make a Will save to end the spell early. A winged creature who is paralyzed cannot flap its wings and falls. A swimmer can’t swim and may drown.
